$comment: Known real builds of the E46 (BUILD_PROMPT 6.5), all E46 M3s (S54B32). Chosen before running the model, by the rules in docs/research-notes/part2b.md. Excluded: the Active Autowerke PRIMA supercharger sheet (the sheet says 426.69 whp, the maker's own page 395 whp for the same run), the CSL-airbox and MSS54HP builds (another engine program and a tuned-runner air box the model can't represent), the MotoIQ Stage 2 car (pulleys change what an inertia dyno reads), cam builds and the forged 330i turbo car. Research: docs/research/part2b/known-builds-bmw-3-series-e46.json.
